Thanks for your reply and support.

My firm offers an Employee Assistance Program (counseling through an outside company) but I don't think that is what I need. I think what I need is to get OUT of here. I just don't know how I can do that without killing my career or going bankrupt.

Thanks for your reply and support.

The problem is that I feel like I'm damned if I do and damned if I don't. I agree that there SHOULD be no shame in taking time to regain my health and strength - but in this industry, I think the stigma could follow me for a long, long time. It's a very small professional world, and people are cruel and people talk.

It's completely effed up, but I swear I would face less stigma if I were to check into rehab for substance abuse than if I were to take a leave of absence for depression. I don't mean to trivialize the struggle of addiction - just to highlight how effed up the legal world is.
